title: Gallery library
subtitle: Keep folders and archives together, then open or rescan them when you need them.
dialogDescription: Choose multiple folders or archives. Nothing is copied or uploaded.
dropToStage: Drop folders or archives here to add them to this batch.
stagedEmpty: No folders or archives selected yet.
removeDescription: This only removes the library entries. Your original files and caches are not deleted.
noSourcesDescription: Add folders and archives once, then return to them without browsing for the path again.
noResultsDescription: Try another search or change the type filter.
renameDescription: Give this source a display name. Its path will not change.
openFailed: This gallery could not be opened.
